name: Microglia
short_description: Brain-resident macrophage with a small soma and many thin, highly branched processes that constantly probe the tissue, clear debris and prune synapses; yolk-sac derived and the CNS's first line of immune defence.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; compact soma with correct quarter-style cutaway showing a small bean-shaped nucleus with a visible dense heterochromatin band, lysosomes, a phagosome with an engulfed debris fragment, mitochondria, rough ER and a Golgi stack, surrounded by 7-10 thin, repeatedly branching processes tipped with small bulbous ends; muted dusty palette, thin clean outlines, neutral dark-charcoal full-bleed background matching the textbook house style, no baked text or border

sem.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; single compact domed soma with a fine, densely and repeatedly forked arbour reaching to the frame edges, false-colour sandy-beige-to-coral surface-only rendering on a dark charcoal background matching the sem exemplar, correctly shows no interior organelles since SEM is surface-only, no text or border)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; small soma with soft translucent cut-away revealing a bean-shaped nucleus with a dark heterochromatin band, lysosomes, a phagosome, mitochondrion with cristae, rough ER and Golgi in clearly distinguishable natural biological tints against a warm cell body, radiating fine branching processes, clean dark studio background, no text or border)

watercolor.1: fail (gemini-2.5-flash-image; otherwise correct full-bleed aged-paper composition with a fine lace-like branching arbour, but a baked-in italic Latin caption "MICROGLIA HUMANA" appears beneath the specimen - violates the no-baked-text golden rule; superseded)
watercolor.2: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; fix-prompt re-render with an explicit no-caption instruction - text removed, elongated soma with visible nucleus (dark crescent with dense band), phagosome (debris fragment in a pale sac), lysosomes, mitochondria and rough ER painted in soft translucent washes, full-bleed warm aged paper with a soft wash halo behind the cell matching the watercolor exemplar, no text or border)
